title: 第十一章 给你看个大宝贝
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册

第(1/3)页

深层大峡谷遗迹。

黑暗中，荧光闪烁，照亮了几道人影，

他们是一只冒险队，带着武器和装备，但从破损度能看出来，之前经历了惨烈的战斗。

“妈的，总算是到了...”

领头的人拿着地图，看到了前方和地图上标识相似的景观，一座三叉戟形状的山峰。

“头儿，那里真的有传说的秘境吗？我们这一路上，可死了不少人啊。”身后的队员喘息着说道。

“情报不会错的，而且，检测仪都已经发现了在那里的强烈魔力反应，一定不会错的...”

队长的目光渐渐阴冷下来。

“为了来到这里，我们付出了这么大的代价，但只要得到了那件宝物，得到无与伦比的力量，金钱，权力...统统不是问题！还要杀光那些排斥我们的人，证明我主，才是世间最伟大的存在！”

“那，之后我是不是就能强娶小芳了？”

“没出息！到时候全天下的漂亮女人都是我们的！”队长大笑着说道。

他笑着笑着就咳嗽起来，

“咳咳....不说了，赶紧的，我们走。”他缓过来后，带着队员朝着山下走去。

很快的，他们看到了秘境的入口，那是一块淡蓝色的空间碎片，突兀的出现在两块岩石之中，

那就是秘境的入口，他们已经能够从中感受到一阵阵强烈的魔力波动。

“是真的！！”

所有人都忍不住欢呼起来，

但队长的笑容还没持续多久，就看到了个让他极度恐惧的画面。

在秘境入口的旁边，生着一个小火堆，而在火堆上正架着一只巨型米诺陶的脑袋，就是一路上杀戮了他们十多名队员，凶猛至极的魔兽。

此时却被斩首后架在了火上，像是餐食般被烤着。

在火堆前坐着个黑发的身影，他的身边还插着一根黑衫木手杖。

对方听到声音，扭过头来，嘴角还带着油光，看到了他们。

“哦，辛苦你们了，大老远跑这么一趟。”他抬起手，笑呵呵的对他们打招呼。

“不过，这里是我先找到的，就先来后到了。”

队长听懂了他的意思，脸色一变，立刻想要拔出魔杖，

但来不及了，一道金光闪过，扑通几声，地上倒下了几具毫无生气的无头身体。

亚枫抹了抹嘴巴，站起身，握着手杖，朝着秘境入口走去。

那蓝色的时空碎片闪烁几下，化作了一道旋转着的漩涡，他伸手，触碰，接着整个人消失在了原地。

闹哄哄的市场内，到处弥漫着土腥味和青菜的味道，周围的人大声的讲着价，地上丢满了烂菜叶子，还有家禽的羽毛到处飘。

“喏，给你的钱。”

老板将一叠钞票递给了伊尔萨，

她数了数后，略有尴尬的抬起头：

“老板，怎么比上次少了一块钱...”

“没办法，这个月和精灵的进口法案签下来了，现在本国的农产品都快跌完了，现在收购都这个价。”老板说道。

“但，但我卖的是鸡蛋啊。”

“我也没办法啊，小妹妹，收购价也不是我定的。”老板无奈地摊摊手。

“...老板，通融一下行不行？我的....爸爸，亚枫之前都来您这里卖货的。”伊尔莎只好打起了感情牌。

“你是亚枫的女儿？”老板扬起了眉毛。

“对啊。”

“那行。”

接着老板从她手里抽走了两张钞票。

“上次那小子还欠我两块钱没还，正好从这里扣吧。”

“...”

Page (1/3)

Deep ruins of the Grand Canyon.

In the darkness, fluorescent lights flickered, illuminating several figures.

They were an adventurous team with weapons and equipment, but judging from the damage, they had experienced fierce battles before.

"Damn, it's finally here..."

The leader held the map and saw a landscape in front of him that was similar to the one marked on the map, a trident-shaped mountain peak.

"Boss, is there really a legendary secret realm there? Many people died along the way." The team member behind him gasped.

"The information is not wrong, and the detector has already detected the strong magic reaction there, so it must not be wrong..."

The captain's eyes gradually turned cold.

"We paid such a high price to get here, but as long as we get that treasure and get unparalleled strength, money, power...it won't be a problem! We also have to kill all those who reject us and prove that our Lord is the greatest existence in the world!"

"Then, can I forcefully marry Xiaofang from now on?"

"There is no future! By then all the beautiful women in the world will be ours!" the captain said with a laugh.

He laughed and coughed,

"Ahem...Stop talking, hurry up, let's go." After he recovered, he led the team members down the mountain.

Soon, they saw the entrance to the secret realm, which was a piece of light blue space debris that suddenly appeared among two rocks.

That was the entrance to the secret realm, and they could already feel strong waves of magic power from it.

"It's true!!"

Everyone couldn't help but cheer,

But the captain's smile didn't last long before he saw a scene that frightened him extremely.

Next to the entrance to the secret realm, there was a small fire, and on the fire was the head of a giant Minotaur, an extremely ferocious monster that had killed more than ten of their team members along the way.

At this time, he was beheaded and put on the fire, roasting like a meal.

Sitting in front of the fire was a black-haired figure, with a blackwood cane stuck beside him.

When the other party heard the sound, he turned his head and saw them with a glossy mouth.

"Oh, thank you for traveling all the way." He raised his hand and greeted them with a smile.

"However, I found this place first, so I arrived first."

The captain understood what he meant, his expression changed, and he immediately wanted to pull out his wand.

But it was too late, a golden light flashed, and with a few plops, several lifeless, headless bodies fell to the ground.

Yafeng wiped his mouth, stood up, held his cane, and walked towards the entrance of the secret realm.

The blue space-time fragment flickered a few times and turned into a rotating vortex. He reached out and touched it, and then the whole person disappeared from the spot.

The noisy market was filled with the smell of earth and vegetables. People around were loudly bargaining about prices. The ground was littered with rotten vegetable leaves, and poultry feathers were floating everywhere.

"Here, here's the money for you."

The boss handed a wad of banknotes to Ilsa.

After counting, she raised her head slightly embarrassed:

"Boss, why is the money less than last time..."

"There is no way. The import bill with the elves was signed this month. Now the country's agricultural products are almost gone, and now they are purchased at this price." The boss said.

"But, what I sell is eggs."

"There's nothing I can do, little sister, I didn't set the purchase price." The boss spread his hands helplessly.

"...Boss, can you please be accommodating? My...Dad, Yafeng has come to your place to sell goods before." Ilsa had no choice but to play the emotional card.

"Are you Ya Feng's daughter?" The boss raised his eyebrows.

"Yes."

"That's okay."

Then the boss took two bills from her hand.

"Last time, the boy still owed me two yuan, so I can just deduct it from here."

"..."
